notes.title: Wall Running Update
notes.content:
0.2.1.2.0 Wall Running Update

05/19/25

	Added Wall Running

	-Added wall running system that detects walls on either side of player on input (default Ctrl) and linearly interpolates the standard gravity to the gravity I derive from the impact normal of the overlapping wall over a timeline then quickly reverse back

	-Player can now run along wall for a short period of time (approx. 3 steps)

	Added Extra Slow Motion Tier

	-If player can eliminate 4 or more enemies in any 20 second period

	*The slow time indicator will change from blue to red

	*Time will slow down an extra interval

	*Players speed is doubled relative to speed at that time dilation (.11)

	*Bullets now travel at .3 speed relative

	-Slow time capsules now change indicator to gold while active

	-Indicator will be orange if both are active

	

		
	Bugs

	-Fixed async loading coming back with null actors at begin play

	-Fixed new vehicle upgrade tint not being applied
'
	-Fixed numerous async spawning issues

	-Fixed not all items dropping from NPCs

	-Fixed decals attaching to invalid surfaces during destruction of said surface

	-Adjusted camera shake to be more realistic (recoil)

	-Fixed survival walls not fully crumbling effecting enemy AI responses

	-Fixed not putting weapons away before entering tanks or helicopters

	-Fixed freezing issues that was extremely rare and hard to replicate, wouldn't crash the game or log an issues, when a level was unloading, and had a TV playing a cutscene, in a packaged game rarely on the first startup if I waited outside the player house then left the game would freeze, had to change tv playback to interaction only.


	Misc

	-Removed "camera lag" setting from third person camera sprint arm, elimination issue where the crosshair goes over the player

notes.title: Gun Running Update!
notes.content:
0.2.1.0.0

3/30/25

Gun Running Update
	

	
	Gun Running


		Added Car Dealership

			Has ability to upgrade cars

			Is a front for illegal bulk weapon distribution via auction

			Kill all guards and owner plus pay $10,000,000 to own business and unlock auction privileges

			Added auction functionality

				Player initiates auction via dealership ownership

				Crowd gathers to witness

				Player proceeds to desk to start auction

				Auction runs quickly item through item rewarding a random amount of cash within a value range

			Wrote a car spawner creator spline to spawn mass amounts of cars with finely tuned amounts of randomness to car type quantity 			and color allowing easy scaling with high optimization 

		Added Pawn Shop

			Functions as normal store

			Is a front for supplying illegal bulk weapons to player for sale

			Kill all guards and owner plus pay $7,500,000 to own business and get a major discount on crates

			Once supply is taken over a custom gun wall will spawn with all of the players gun wall weapons, and will allow for gun 			upgrades even if that has not been previously unlocked withing the house upgrades.

		Added Crate carrying system and crate instance bulk items

			Player can now seamlessly buy bulk crates of guns walk around with them and drop them at will

		Added Box Truck

			Has attached saved inventory set up specifically for bulk weapon crate carrying

			Truck can be parked inside car dealership to "sell all guns" or if Dealership is owned "send crates to auction"

			Truck automatically spawns at pawn shop and car dealer as long as no other truck is spawned in world (abandoning truck will cause despawn but inventory will always be saved)

		Added Explainer Cutscene

		Added expandable mini map with location icons for NPCs and the player, with 4 different zoom settings and a full screen mode

Misc

	Upgraded merchant interaction for buying ammo, now when you have full ammo of a type the buy button is red, and if not it is green, also hovering over an ammo type will bring up a tool tip showing current ammo/max ammo
	
	Adjusted camera shake on weapon animations

	Made player mappable controls accessible from any vehicle or on foot

	Shortened car exit time

	Made 30 mm cannon on heli aimable from 3rd person view

	Added foliage

	Got custom tv material working with nanite

	Added early access disclaimer

	Added content disclaimer
	
	Updated map to reflect new missions and locations


Effects

	Minor overhaul of lights for appearance and performance (will make more improvements with Unreal 5.5 which i will be upgrading to soon)

	Improved helicopter failing and crashing

	Changed how tracers are calculated resulting in a much more responsive feel

	Fixed physics on time dilation (slomo) had to write a custom formula to adjust for the wanky time dilation physics in UE, basically lerped the time dilation value tor the desired value at .03 per tick.

	Changed pitch of audio effects during slow motion

	Fixed minigun animation and audio problems with slow motion
		
	Remade vehicle explosion effects to a much more optimized, but better looking, version allowing for mass chain reaction explosions to hundreds of vehicles with minimal performance loss


Bugs

	Fixed issue with starter pistol, not working after being reequipped

	Turned of async physics tick on dozens of files, has been causing crashed and freezes

	Fixed large missile damage issues

	Fixed glitch where player was not removing NPC from vehicle while car jacking

	Fixed vehicle collision glitches

	Tuned road props to work better with vehicle hits

	Fixed building collisions on the two strip malls
	
	Fixed death cam movement issues

	Fixed issues with damaged sheetrock collisions, specifically on models that I had used a Boolean operation for, basically just made collisions mot interact with player pawn

	Fixed issues where functions were trying to reach the main character through an interphase but were getting the possessed pawn

	Fixed issues with interacting with merchants on rare occasions if merchant or player was moved outside of interaction zone player would be stuck in ui

	Fixed issue with traffic getting stuck in death loop in problem areas of the road spline

	Fixed bugs with enemy ai vehicles

	Fixed guard and merchant despawning; they were on normal distance check then destroy, in rare cases depending on distance of level streaming overlap player could get the level streamed in and the guards and merchants spawned to have them despawn by time they arrive, I linked them to the streaming level so they will spawn and depawn reliably in level 

	Fixed issue with switching aiming sides feature (default m while on foot) was adjusting aim poorly, changed it to take x and z coordinates from existing camera boom

	Fixed issue with elevator spawning destructible components, created multiple files with async spawning at runtime to solve the problem and increase performance

	Fixed bug with save game not adding ammo for equipped gun if said gun has upgrades

	Fixed camera shake being applied when ai was shooting

	Fixed initialization bug with vehicle spawning

Drug Dealing Update

	Added destructible TVs with playable cutscenes

	New bullet holes

notes.title: 0.1.1.2.1 Optimization Update
notes.content:
Changed duration until wanted level lost from 120 sec per wanted level to 80 sec.

	Fixed glitch where player was able to spend more money than they have at the gun wall, resulting in negative balance

	Fixed glitch where some enemy AI were freezing in some situations

	Fixed issue where some of the cars had the wrong size wheels set up for physics

	Removed dozens of unused variables across all files

	Removed 100s of hard dependencies in dozens of files

	Cleaned up code in use and deleted unused code and files

	Adjusted left hand grip location on AR 4

	Fixed issues with destroyed buildings sounds and visual effects

	Fixed issues with player in car being able to interact with player only interactions

	Fixed dozens of packaging warnings (mostly just refreshing files saved in older versions of unreal) making packaging quicker

	Fixed camera lag issues on player and cars, was causing stuttering

	Fixed issue where player was stuck in seated position when exiting vehicle with broken driver side door

	Fixed issue where car would keep accelerating if player exited with broken driver side door while accelerating

	Fixed attack Heli not chasing player
	
	Increased high end volume clamp on upgraded vehicle engine sound

	Lengthened despawn distance for enemy AI, logic had prevented enemies reaching certain map areas, and reducing respawn for performance and playability (enemy AI respawning too soon makes loosing a wanted level much harder and less realistic)

	Enabled async physics on vehicles

	Changed optimization settings in vehicle and road files

	Changed foliage setting to evaluate world position false enable density scaling true and enable cull distance true fixing foliage scalability

	Changed sheetrock and glass destroyed master files to not reference any effects, async load when needed then pool and relocate effects
	
	Changed all projectiles to async physics and enabled optimization settings

	Removed static mesh from master inventory item file reducing overhead

	Reset all shelving positions to restore items after inventory item alteration

	Set all remaining geometry collection files (destructible meshes) to use async physics

	Optimized main NPC file

	Optimized pedestrian enemy AI and main character animation blueprints

	Optimized pedestrian and enemy AI's Artificial Intelligence Controllers

	Fixed descriptions on pistols and smg 11s

	Removed animations and mesh from master gun item

	Fixed guardrail anchor glitch

	Fixed Heli Enter glitch and explode glitch

	Fixed Cop car reversing at stop

	Created vehicle swapping system for low memory vehicles to be default
	
	Reduced shadow complexity on broken components

	Fixed glitches in inventory to do with dropping and destroying consumables and Hud display updates

	Reduced shadow complexity on inventory items

	Added random delay to inventory items becoming visible after spawn (reduces hitching)

	Fixed glitches with elevator

	Made physics push double doors in hospital work better

	Changed stationary items mobility to static when not simulating physics

	Changed how enemy AI is aware of player's location and wanted level

	Changed how info about communications being down between enemy AI is transferred

	Tuned destructible buildings for better performance and look

	Fixed pause menu issues

	Turned on pooling for all emitters

	Made new Niagara effect for destructible buildings

	Changed how buildings destroy glass and lights when destroyed

	Fixed materials on billboard signs
 	
	New intro screen Niagara cash effect instead of meshes falling allowing for 4x the frame rate and at least 10x cash bundles

notes.title: NPC/AI Update
notes.content:
0.1.1.0.0

10/13/24
	
NPC/AI Update

	Wanted level system overhaul

		Fixed some wanted levels coming from traffic accidents not related to player's actions
	
		Fixed enemy AI not shooting at you until enter car montage finishes

		Adjusted AI target confirmation before shooting

		Doubled amount of time it takes to lose police (120s per wanted lvl)

		Added police sirens with related functions including player use (default Q Key)

		Wanted level functionality improvements

	Traffic system overhaul

		New car spawning system

		New road system

		New intersection system giving AI ability to make random decisions and allowing police to follow player better
	
		New vehicle AI obstacle avoidance

		Added AI traffic beeping on obstacle avoidance

	Optimized gas station 

		Explosions changed to multi explosion system

		Disallowed the floor cave in

		Charred material applied on gas station explosion event

	Survival wall optimization

	Blueprint optimization (generate component data on build)

	Default settings lowered for performance

	Foliage optimization nanite triangle reduction

	Fixed broken glass collisions pushing player through floor

	Fixed cash registers on top of breaking glass effect

	Fixed merchants spawning not standing still

	Changed NPC spawning system to Mass AI system (planning on full Mass AI implementation soon waiting for Unreal 5.5.3)

	Fixed hacking(gameplay mechanic) issues

	Split up main road for better performance

	Fixed minor issue with extra foliage instances begin generated

	Fixed issue where player was spawning at location 0,0,0 when exiting a car with damaged door

	Added not enough cash and/or not enough parking spots warnings to car upgrade menu

	Fixed small error where an empty array was assigned to the trunk inventory on cars that were not player owned

notes.title: Mugging and Player Map Update
notes.content:
0.1.0.2.0 (Changed Version numbers, "survival mode" update should have been 0.1.0.1.0 new system is Mainversion.MajorSystemUpgrade.MajorFeatureAddition.MinorFeatureAdittionOrUpgrade.MinorPatch


	Mugging and player maps update

	
	Added player maps with player location for sandbox and survival maps

	Added mugging functionality to Civilians and merchants

	Added enemy AI behavior, if gun is aimed at them, or any character it will result in an instant wanted level 2

	Added areas in police stations that are off limits and entry will give the player a wanted level of 2
	
	Adjusted lighting in army vaults

	Added multiple types of hackable computers across sandbox map and enabled destruction

	Added interior items to department store backrooms including a large safe hackable computers and storage shelving

	Added ability to sell unowned cars (need to build system for selling owned cars in future)

	Added more detailed how to play section on main menu

notes.title: Major bug fixes & added Survival Mode
notes.content:
0.1.0.0.5 	

8/5/24

	Fixed destroyed buildings giving off dust when characters touched them

	Added hackability to substation communication computers

	Added Hackable Computers for cash

	Adjusted collision capsule so character doesn't get stuck when trying to jump through windows

	Fixed scaling issues with some destroyed doors (unreal geometry collection fractures do not like being scaled, leads to major physics issues)

	Fixed issue with buildings that would make it so the interior sheetrock was not being destroyed when the building was hit, the function bpi destruction was only enabled for glass types inheriting from the same class, may lead to unforeseen issues, the sheetrock can be problematic

	Changed some drink cases to make stealing from closed case harder

	Adjusted item interact culls

	Disabled tick on some items

	Changed sliding door opening and closing function to stay open until all characters are clear, helps NPCs function properly

	Fixed issue where player would consume multiple consumables

	Fixed menu interaction in merchant and chest

	Made loot impossible to sell to merchants

	Made starting interaction with merchant with wanted level impossible 
	
	Fixed car trunk, needed to be recompiled
	
	Added autosave on quit (main menu button) from pause menu sandbox only
	
	Fixed Minigun cooldown after interruption or no ammo 

	Fixed Minigun dynamic color being added to other main guns

	Fixed misc minigun issues

	Fixed exit car with damaged and/or blocked door (teleport Exit)

	Fixed misc gun animation issues on player and AI
		
		Socket locations on skeleton

		Ai was not using animation, was using old logic of spawning in individual animation components

	Developed slightly more robust code for AI fixing several issues (currently working on a completely new system based on mass ai)

	Resized 762 impacts

	Fixed AI crouching issue

	Adjusted NPC run away parameters

	Got enemy AI to stop shooting each other and NPCs (mostly)

	Fixed AI not navigating through doors

	Fixed bugs in patrolling enemy AI

	Added more randomized enemy ai behavior

	Changed AI shooting patterns maintaining similar accuracy, but adding more variety giving a slightly more realistic feel

		Adjusted pitch to be more varied

		Adjusted yaw to be more accurate
	
	Changed shotgun damage decal to multi hole for objects

	Adjusted left hand grip sockets on misc weapons

	Added survival mode!

		Added explainer intro animation with different camera angles

		Built save logic to bring exp player level and cash back to sandbox game

			Designed to only save on successful exfil

		Made new spawning system for wave based enemies
	
		Made new spawning system for traffic props

		Designed end level extraction

		Made loot items instantly cash out in this mode

		fixed loot drops from bodies falling through floors

		Created new level with a new kind of multi stage cascading barrier, where each section breaks as a whole, they get damaged, then slowly break exposing next level section
